title: Q&A with Timnit Gebru, who says the "existential risk" narrative is a harmful marketing strategy and the "stochastic parrots" metaphor is not outdated (Lauren Goode/Wired)
summary: Lauren Goode / Wired: Q&A with Timnit Gebru, who says the “existential risk” narrative is a harmful marketing strategy and the “stochastic parrots” metaphor is not outdated — One of AI's fiercest critics believes the doom talk is about founders making money, not saving humanity.
contentText:
Lauren Goode / Wired :

Q&A with Timnit Gebru, who says the “existential risk” narrative is a harmful marketing strategy and the “stochastic parrots” metaphor is not outdated   —  One of AI's fiercest critics believes the doom talk is about founders making money, not saving humanity.
